findings.label: Keyboard-focus row reads as locator.press('Tab')
findings.location: .kiro/skills/heuristic-ux-audit/references/evidence-capture.md:207 (§ Interaction states table, keyboard focus row)
findings.issue: The row says "focus() on a text input or press('Tab') to a button, then toBeFocused()". Its neighbours focus() and fill() are calls on the control, so it reads as trigger.press('Tab'); Playwright 1.62's locator.press focuses the element and then presses the key (playwright-core/types/types.d.ts:15990), which moves focus off the button, so toBeFocused() fails and that control's later states (popover open, an item chosen, High Contrast) are lost until the spec is fixed. The eval's + Filter trigger is such a button (apps/web/src/w360/ui.tsx:568-574).
findings.action: Reword the row to: focus() on the control, from a fresh load or after a key press, never straight after a click, then toBeFocused(). The coder's High Contrast re-check (eval-traceability.md, rows 1, 5 and 6) shows that recipe matching :focus-visible on a button in both Chromium and WebKit.
